contribution: Developing econometric methods for analyzing demand, market power and competition in differentiated-product markets, which founded modern empirical industrial organization
rationale: This is a judgment call from my own knowledge, not a sure forecast. Recent prizes went to macro and growth topics (innovation-driven growth in 2025) and institutions (2024), so a microeconomics prize looks likely in 2026. Empirical IO is a long-standing gap. The Berry-Levinsohn-Pakes framework (1995) is highly cited and widely used in antitrust and merger review, and its authors appear on citation-based laureate lists.
